findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_filings, x402_check, caller_avoidance_score, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, clinical_trial_study, fda_adverse_events, sec_8k_filings, sec_13f_holdings, email_auth_audit, text_pii_redact · Private data: sanctions_address_check, climate_day, sec_filings, injection_scan, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, sec_8k_filings, email_auth_audit, text_pii_redact, solana_pre_promo · Public sink: injection_scan, caller_avoidance_score, email_auth_audit, text_pii_redact, solana_pre_promo · Destructive: fda_ndc_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sec_filings, x402_check, caller_avoidance_score, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, clinical_trial_study, fda_adverse_events, sec_8k_filings, sec_13f_holdings, email_auth_audit, text_pii_redact · Private data: sanctions_address_check, climate_day, sec_filings, injection_scan, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, sec_8k_filings, email_auth_audit, text_pii_redact, solana_pre_promo · Public sink: injection_scan, caller_avoidance_score, email_auth_audit, text_pii_redact, solana_pre_promo · Destructive: fda_ndc_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
